items.title: TYL ($$): Mar $410 puts sold
items.summary: 100 March 2027 $410 puts sold to open at $33.52 on 11/18 (open interest 151), plus about 200 March 2027 $450 calls bought at $29.83 on 11/12 and 400 March 2027 $380 calls bought at $20.65 on 10/9; spot $406.70. Shares are down about 10.4% YTD but have held above the 200-day since 10/13, sitting between the 8- and 21-day EMAs with the 50-day near $370 as support and $437 the upside target. Desk lean is the put sale on a pullback toward the 50-day; $$ Featured, not the $$$ list.

items.title: CAH ($$): Jun $220 puts sold
items.summary: 375 June 2027 $220 puts sold to open at $6.20 on 11/10 (open interest 498), plus 275 January 2028 $320 calls bought at $22.02 on 11/23; spot $272.00. Shares are up about 32% YTD after a raised fiscal-year outlook, with the $286.29 high from 11/5 as resistance and the 21-day EMA the first support on this pullback. Desk lean is the put sale on a pullback toward the 21-day; $$ Featured, not the $$$ list.

items.title: Desk market wrap 11/23
items.summary: Tech led a sharp rebound as Asian authorities moved to support markets; semis were the standout and the VIX fell back under 30. The S&P stays below its 200-day, with resistance 7,330 and support 6,970. Size calls bought in ENTG, LRCX, MRVL, ARM; puts sold to open in WMT, TGT, BURL.

items.title: TJX ($$$): Dec $140 puts sold
items.summary: 3,000 December $140 puts sold at $7.85 on 11/11, 5,100 December $120 short puts opened at $1.04 (open interest now 6,022), December $140 put open interest 4,570; 2,000 December $145 calls bought at $2 still holding (3,307); spot $139.60. Shares are down about 9.1% YTD, rebounded off the September low, and are back above the 50-day. Desk lean agrees with the put sellers as a way to own the name into the holiday quarter and the February report.

items.title: CHTR ($$): Dec $145 calls bought
items.summary: 1,000 December $145 calls bought at $7.14 to $7.30 on 11/13 (open interest 1,105), plus 190 January 2029 $70 ITM calls bought for $1.1M on 10/26; spot $128.70. Shares are down about 38.3% YTD, up about 27% off the 10/26 low near $101, with ten straight closes above the 50-day and the 11/17 high near $143 as resistance. Desk lean is that the call buyers make it worth starting upside exposure into the January report; $$ Featured, not the $$$ list.

items.title: Desk market wrap 11/20
items.summary: Heavy selling Friday as the S&P broke below 7,000 to new lows and the VIX moved back above 30. Rotation out of tech into housing, staples, and insurance, with bonds bid.

items.title: CELH ($$$): Sep 2027 $47.50/$65 call spreads bought
items.summary: 50,000 September 2027 $47.50/$65 call spreads bought on 8/6 and still in open interest, alongside 7,000 June $35/$32.50 short strangles and more than 5,000 January $35 puts sold; spot $30.88. Energy drink leader sold off Thursday after tagging the 200-day, down about 33% YTD. Desk lean is that the name can work higher in 2027 on new product launches and international upside.

items.title: TEL ($$$): Feb $230 calls bought
items.summary: 2,000 February $230 calls bought for about $2M on 11/17 (open interest now 5,532), following 1,250 of the same on 11/6 and 325 February 2027 $230 calls at $10.88 on 11/2; spot $211.20. The expiry spans the Jan 20 report. Shares sit back under the 50- and 200-day with $230 as resistance and about $200 as support. Desk lean is following the February $230 call buyers into the report at a low forward multiple.

items.title: BBIO ($$): Feb $80 calls bought
items.summary: 1,500 February $80 calls bought at $7.20 (~$1M), plus 650 May $75 and 550 February $85 calls bought; spot $78.20. Call buyers are stepping in ahead of a heavy catalyst calendar, with the November 27 PDUFA date first. Desk lean is owning upside calls into the launch stretch; $$ Featured, not the $$$ list.

items.title: HSIC ($$$): Apr $85 calls bought
items.summary: 1,850 April $85 calls bought in the $5.50 to $6.70 range on 11/18, adjusting some November $75 calls from 5/8; spot $85.65. Rebound off the rising 200-day, with shares outperforming in 2026 and recent highs stalled at the 2022 highs. Unusual call volume a day after a healthcare conference presentation. Desk lean is the April call buy as a low-valuation own in a safer area, though options liquidity is thin.

items.title: KO ($$): Feb 2027 $105 calls bought
items.summary: 5,300 February 2027 $105 calls bought at $2.26, plus 4,000 March $95 calls bought and 1,600 May $90 puts sold; spot $98.10. Near all-time highs. Desk lean is the February 2027 call buy; $$ Featured, not the $$$ list.

items.title: MCD joins the $$$ Shopping List
items.summary: 2,500 December $285 calls bought at $3.30 to $3.35 on 11/17 in a name that rarely sees large trades (about 5,000 traded on the day); spot $275.82. Shares are forming a bull flag below the declining 200-day, with the 50% retracement at $285 as resistance and $298 the target. Cheap calls on a clean chart; the Desk lean is the December call buy.

items.title: ZTS ($$): Dec $75 puts sold
